comment: this is not centered with jynx menu on vertical
actionLog: Fixed: .dev-toolbar-grip wasn't wrapped in .jynx-toolbar-item so it missed that class's align-self:center override under .dev-fab-toolbar.vertical's align-items:stretch, leaving it flush against the column edge instead of centered like the icon buttons below it. Added align-self:center directly to .dev-toolbar-grip. PR #52.
